## TASK-003 - Implement immutable publication and recovery

Implement standard-library protected publication of versioned messages, corrections and recipient receipts into participant-owned immutable namespaces with payload-bound operation IDs and recoverable pending delivery.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-018, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-027, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-033, REQ-042, REQ-046, REQ-051, REQ-052, REQ-053, REQ-058, REQ-063 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaborate.py, SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaboration_store.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-002 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Directory-relative no-follow access, exclusive final publication and directory durability must be supported by the selected host; otherwise report unsupported.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every successful contribution is one complete hash-valid immutable file; corrections retain originals and retries return the same logical result.
- Durability precedes notification; reconstruction preserves undelivered contributions after a crash without republishing them.
- Traversal, symlink, collision, oversized record, corrupt hash, stale generation and forged binding fail closed without outside changes or private diagnostics.

### Planned verification

- Inspect filesystem and diagnostic boundaries; supply the implementation to the single focused test run in TASK-007.

## TASK-004 - Implement authorized reads and task views

Build the shared logical board, replies, scoped filters, bounded read/search/digests, explicit per-recipient acknowledgement and release-aware unread selection through one visibility filter applied before any context-producing output.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-028, REQ-031, REQ-034, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-040, REQ-041, REQ-042, REQ-046, REQ-053, REQ-054, REQ-057, REQ-058, REQ-063 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaboration_read.py, SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaboration_views.py, SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaborate.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-003 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A global read-through cursor can lose newly released earlier posts; do not use it as the authoritative unread state.

### Acceptance criteria

- All required filters and message types are supported; protected titles, bodies, previews, counts and linked artifacts never enter unauthorized output.
- Newly released sealed versions become unread even after later-visible messages were handled; one recipient acknowledgement leaves other recipients pending.
- Read/list/search/validate are nonmutating; explicit rebuild updates only authorized derived Markdown and no canonical Task projection.
- Handling/answered/deferred state is attributed communication evidence and cannot establish comprehension, formal resolution or completion.

### Planned verification

- Review routing through the common pre-exposure filter and pure read paths; use TASK-007 for deterministic proof instead of a second test run.

## TASK-005 - Implement bounded native delivery bookkeeping

Provide persisted pending-delivery requests, bounded checkpoint summaries, explicit actual-tool receipt recording and idempotent reconciliation for execution by the authorized active native owner.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-021, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-027, REQ-028, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-036, REQ-040, REQ-046, REQ-052, REQ-053, REQ-056, REQ-063 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/collaborate/scripts/collaboration_delivery.py, SKILLS-depo/collaborate/references/native-delivery.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-003, TASK-004 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Native messages are not atomic with file publication; actual delivery must not be inferred from a stored request.

### Acceptance criteria

- Persistence, attempted delivery, actual notification and reported reading have separate evidence; failed or uncertain delivery stays pending.
- Routine posts never wake idle participants; manager blockers are attempted at the next available active-session control opportunity.
- Material changes retain observed stop/reconciliation, exact send_message packet, assignment.inputs commit and followup_task order; unchanged resume retains assignment.resume.
- No shell-launched agent, new broker, model polling loop or unattended service is introduced.

### Planned verification

- Inspect the active-owner/native boundary and retry state; reuse TASK-007 failure evidence and TASK-011 actual idle/interruption receipts.

## TASK-006 - Connect communication evidence to current decision gates

Implement minimal Task-owner integration for policy release, selected immutable snapshots, material-change eligibility and unresolved-thread assessment at review, synthesis, acceptance and completion boundaries.

| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-004, TASK-005 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Harmless speculative posts must not become universal vetoes or restart every Task.

### Acceptance criteria

- Selected snapshots name exact versions, hashes, included coverage and omissions through existing artifact/input events; no full conversation enters canonical JSON.
- Material target changes invalidate only affected review, synthesis, acceptance and implementation eligibility while preserving historical and unchanged evidence.
- Senior and manager assess material objections with attributable decisions; informal closure, alleged approval, votes and done-posts cannot clear owner gates.
- If current Task validators need no change, retain their bytes and implement the adapter alone; any necessary extension follows TASK-002 approved compatibility design.

### Planned verification

- Inspect the adapter and any exact validator diff against current owner gates; exercise only the affected paths in TASK-007 and TASK-012.

| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- One parameterized case per materially distinct negative boundary is necessary; broad fuzz, load, package and repository suites are excluded.

### Acceptance criteria

- Bundle D1 covers concurrent publication, collision preservation, duplicate same/conflicting payloads, corrupt/incomplete files, publication-before-delivery and one crash-recovery injection (REQ-051/052).
- Bundle D2 covers stale generations, every supported exposure route, sealed/released unread posts, per-recipient receipts, read-only/rebuild state boundaries, and one negative example for each required unauthorized-scope/file/privacy boundary (REQ-053/054/057/058).
- Bundle D3 covers current Task compatibility, category/owner preservation, exact snapshots/input gates, material invalidation and unresolved or informally closed objections (REQ-055/059); reuse applicable existing tests where sufficient.
- Bundle D4 covers successful message vocabulary, replies/corrections, each required filter, bounded output/remaining coverage and distinct communication handling states.
- Synthetic fixtures are labeled deterministic evidence, never native isolation, comprehension or pilot proof; passing unchanged cases are not rerun later.

### Planned verification

- Run once after TASK-003 through TASK-006 stabilize: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s SKILLS-depo/collaborate/tests -p test_collaboration_acceptance.py.
- If a Task validator changed, run only existing regression methods for that affected event/gate not already covered by D3; record each method and reason. Rerun only cases affected by a correction.
